subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview/sample first-run tour be adopted on top of the current onboarding refresh, narrowed into a smaller follow-up, or closed in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The branch adds a new preview-tour onboarding product surface while current main and open PRs have changed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions, so automation cannot choose the permanent product shape.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography and fresh first-run/preview/configured-user proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path and onboarding error improvements to the newer focused PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh and open focused onboarding PRs as the maintained direction if the preview-tour surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography and fresh first-run/preview/configured-user proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged mobile onboarding/security refresh that now defines much of the current baseline this branch must rebase onto.
